description: Source code for the PoolBuilder class, which manages creation and configuration of FixturePools for test suites in a testing framework.

classes.name: PoolBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for building and managing fixture pools for test suites, supporting different modes ('loader' and 'worker').

methods.name: createForLoader
methods.description: Static method to create a PoolBuilder instance configured for 'loader' mode.

methods.name: createForWorker
methods.description: Static method to create a PoolBuilder instance configured for 'worker' mode with a specified project.

methods.name: buildPools
methods.description: Builds fixture pools for all tests in a suite, assigning pools or digests based on mode.

methods.name: _buildPoolForTest
methods.description: Creates a fixture pool for a specific test, including parent suite hooks and modifiers.

methods.name: _buildTestTypePool
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a fixture pool for a specific test type, with project-specific overrides.

methods.name: _handleLoadError
methods.description: Handles load errors by either appending to testErrors or throwing an error with formatted location.
